name: PENGWIN 2024
description: PENGWIN 2024 is a medical imaging benchmark for segmenting pelvic fracture fragments in CT scans and simulated X-ray images. It targets accurate delineation of complex bone fragments to support trauma diagnosis, surgical planning, and intraoperative guidance.
evaluation_method: Multi-metric segmentation evaluation, typically using Dice score and related overlap / boundary metrics aggregated across cases and modalities.
notes: Includes 150 multi-center CT scans and simulated X-ray data generated with DeepDRR. The challenge used a rigorous multi-metric testing scheme. The abstract snippet truncates the exact top score, so typical SOTA is not specified here.
